description: Creates a Coinbase checkout for any SKU — use this when no job-named tool exists. Returns x402_url (pay with any x402 client), pay_url (human) and claim_url. Does not move money itself.

address.description: Digital currency address to exact-match — sanctions-wallet-screen

broker_mc.description: Broker MC/docket number — load-vet-pack (runs the broker-authority check)

license_line.description: Texas insurance (TDI) license line — tx-insurance-ce-check: general_lines_life_accident_health_hmo | general_lines_property_casualty | personal_lines_property_casualty | limited_lines | public_adjuster | all_lines_adjuster

license_type.description: Texas real-estate (TREC) license type — tx-realestate-ce-check: sales_agent | broker | broker_associate | inspector

name.description: Legal name to screen — sanctions-screen (required there); optional OFAC screen on load-vet-pack

pair.description: e.g. USD-KES; required for pair shelves

sku.description: Shelf SKU to buy (required) — any id from list_shelves, e.g. fx-official, load-vet-pack, nb-landing-page

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of a billing export, CSV/JSON up to 10MB — cloud-spend-report

text.description: Text to localize, up to 120 words — swahili-localization-instant

name: buy_shelf
title: Open a purchase for a shelf (escape hatch)
